qa.desc: Aithe mee question undi kadu answered, check<1>Product Documentation</1>kosam inka FAQs, leka contact us.
qa.list.credit.a: Computing credits unnaru a metric vaadina dvara{{cloud}}ki measure AI model usage when calling models. Different AI models consume different amounts yokka computing credits.
qa.list.embeddings.a: Vector storage undi kadu equal ki original size yokka mee uploaded leka imported dataset, but undi calculated based on vectorization yokka pure text content lo mee files. Kosam example, a 1-page PDF file (1000-1500 characters) may only take up gurinchi 1 vector storage entry when extracted mariyu vectorized loki pure text. Meeru can chudandi mee usage under "{{usage}}".
qa.list.free.a: {{name}}undi always adhered ki open cheyyi source principles. Kosam professional developers, meeru can vaadandi anni open cheyyi source capabilities through self-deployment yokka community version. Lo{{cloud}}, we provide anni registered users tho{{credit}}free computing credits per month, ready ki vaadandi lekunda complex configuration. Aithe meeru kavali inka usage, meeru can subscribe ki{{starter}},{{premium}}leka{{ultimate}}.
qa.list.highUsage.a: Credit consumption depends heavily on conversation length. As a conversation grows, prathi new message sends entire charitra as input tokens, which increases cost significantly. We recommend starting a new conversation when topics marchu. Also, aithe there undi a long gap between messages, prompt cache may expire, causing a spike lo cost. Some models laga Gemini Pro series vaadandi tiered pricing — input beyond 200K tokens undi charged at double rate.
qa.list.highUsage.q: Why unnaru my credits being consumed faster than expected?
qa.list.limit.a: {{cloud}}subscription plans unnaru divided loki{{starter}},{{premium}}mariyu{{ultimate}}, prathi providing different computing credits. Aithe mee ippati plan credits unnaru insufficient, we recommend upgrading. Meeru can also purchase credit packages on<fundsLink>"{{funds}}"</fundsLink>page kosam pay-as-you-go usage. Alternatively, meeru can set up a custom model API key ki vaadandi API credits purchased nundi other sources.
qa.list.limit.q: What aithe I run out yokka computing credits?
qa.list.management.a: On{{subscribe}}page, meeru can "Upgrade / Downgrade" mee ippati subscription plan, leka switch between yearly mariyu monthly billing. Through "{{usage}}-{{management}}" meeru can go ki Stripe kosam subscription management, mariyu meeru can raddhu mee subscription at ye time. Taruvata cancellation, meeru will be automatically downgraded ki free version when mee ippati plan expires.
qa.list.management.q: How do I marchu leka raddhu my subscription?
